from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEpsRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from a single company's 10-Q regarding diluted earnings per share."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as reported in the document")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the report (e.g., '2025-03-31' or 'Q1 2025')")
    current_quarter_diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share for the current quarter")
    prior_year_quarter_diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share for the same period in the prior year")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_records: list[CompanyEpsRecord]
